en-US.summary: Read Bible verses, passages, and chapters in your preferred translation
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Bible Reader to read John 3:16
Alexa, ask Bible Reader to read Psalm 23 in NIV
Alexa, ask Bible Reader to read Romans chapter 8
en-US.name: Bible Reader
en-US.description: Bible Reader allows you to listen to any Bible verse, passage, or chapter in multiple translations including KJV, NIV, ESV, and more. Simply ask for a specific verse or passage and choose your preferred version.

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Say 'Alexa, ask Bible Reader to read John 3:16' to test basic functionality.
